pages.title: Catch the Wind
pages.text: Try an independent power source before choosing a larger boiler.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Use the native windmill Ponder scene. Attach valid sails, assemble the rotor, and let the bearing transmit nonzero kinetic power. A loose bearing does not count.

pages.title: How to use it
pages.text: Assemble sails on a Windmill Bearing and activate it; nonzero native output distinguishes power from owning the bearing.
